title: Create: Autocrafting
description: Create:autocrafting adds a whole new function to the stock ticker, on-demand autocrafting requests!
body:
# Create: Autocrafting

Welcome to Create: Autocrafting, an addon that allows you to create a entire on-demand autocrafting system, allowing you to simply request an item from a stock ticker, and it will be crafted if there are enough resources on you network, the desired amount of items to craft you specify while starting a crafting job. Recipe trees are put into consideration, without needing to do the long setup of factory gauges.

# Requirements

*   Minecraft ‹1.20.1›
*   Create ‹6.0.8› or higher
*   Forge 47.~
